Old woman at reception treated me like dirt on her shoe, I have never felt so disrespected by a receptionist in all my life, I don’t know how she still has a job. I have also heard about her making racist remarks towards people.

Most of the people on the phone were rude and condescending save for one, who actually tried to help me and told me I could come in to fill in a referral form physically and hand it in on the same day and they would get it processed quickly for me due to me having an urgent issue that needed seeing.

Upon actually coming in, the receptionist would not allow me to fill in the form there and made me go home to do it, meaning I had to come back the following day, delaying my appointment further. When I did so, she was so incredibly rude and condescending to me and upon realising my title (Mr) didn’t align with my sex on my documents, she very loudly said I would be registered as a MISS, in front of my friend who I had not told I was transgender. She could have put me in serious danger if I had been with someone who wanted to hurt people like me, that was incredibly unprofessional and left me shaken for the rest of the day.

I felt humiliated and disrespected, and she completely disregarded my friend, who was suffering from a lung infection and needed urgent help, telling him she couldn’t help him unless he registered then made an appointment in a couple weeks time. She didn’t even advise him to call 111 or anything, she just sent us both away.

I was so incredibly shocked by this interaction that I couldn’t even see myself visiting this surgery ever again, even for an appointment, if it meant I had to interact with this evil woman. I struggle with anxiety and the thought of going back was haunting me, so I called up again to cancel my registration. I will now have to go to A&E for treatment just because of the incompetency of this medical centre.",null,[0,235]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xCNFZrcHJPVlJrTjBWRWFIZFBiemxrVFdwNlUyYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x4a4c6aff6880fee8!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOlB4VkprOVRkN0VEaHdPbzlkTWp6U2c%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xCNFZrcHJPVlJrTjBWRWFIZFBiemxrVFdwNlUyYxAB&t=1&-gGj_akxKKgswZGNRbXJIbk02Ng&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjt68GQirGTAxU1FWMBHUspAfcQoykIBCgB"],null,[null,[[1,1]]]],"0ahUKEwjt68GQirGTAxU1FWMBHUspAfcQ0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMDVuVG5SUWMxOWZSV2hEVFRWME9VcDZaMjVGU1dOYWJqUkpjMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpRWTBOWk1rRXlNQzEzV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2t4UVFsRTVXRXhvZUZCaU4wWmxNV0Z1YlRSalZsRRAB",["0x0:0x4a4c6aff6880fee8",null,1770226778623812,1770228071926757,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/116073061197865953901/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Sophie","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLqh2zlwleRIz6hH3_nlfrebiX-ukK_vj4HSr1ahO_yYSqhsQ=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/116073061197865953901?hl=en"],"116073061197865953901",null,1,0,null,[0,2,1],0,["1 review",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwjt68GQirGTAxU1FWMBHUspAfcQ7LoGCAYoAA"]]]],null,"a month ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Had to wait 2 weeks for a follow-up appointment just for the doctor to ring me for 5 seconds, so I missed it.
